annotations.title: FXRate: Convert an amount between currencies (ECB rates)

description:
Convert an amount between two currencies at the official ECB reference rate (latest or a past date). Inputs: from, to (ISO codes like USD, EUR, JPY), amount (default 1), date (optional YYYY-MM-DD). Returns rate, result, inverse_rate and the rate date. Free: 30 calls/day per IP, then $0.001 per call via x402 or credits.

[FXRate via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as FXRate's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: convert $0.001 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD (default: latest). Weekends/holidays use the previous ECB rate.

from.description: From currency: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY (31 supported)

tier.description: Paid tier: convert $0.001. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.

to.description: To currency: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY (31 supported)
